title: Sector Zero
subtitle: The future blasters were only prototypes, and something under the track just woke up.

pages.alt: Page 1: Poko lands a 360 carrot-spin combo on the turbo track, Reno drifts past with zero brakes, the green and teal dinos worry their RPM is unsafe, and then something from the future drops out of the sky.
Page 2: Poko pops bubbles at Nino while Reno fires a blue gel blaster, then the white CC-01 car slams in with an alert: those were restricted prototypes, and firing them tripped a silent beacon.
Page 3: the ground cracks open with red light, the teal dino realises the floor is glowing, the green dino reports a massive seismic spike, and CC-01 shouts that this is not a stunt but a breach.
Page 4: a sealed hatch unlocks and smoke pours out of Sector Zero, Poko and CC-01 gear up for a showdown, Reno loads the blue gel, and the two dinos hope whatever is rising is a friendly giant.

Page 5: a huge silhouette with red eyes stirs in the smoke, Poko and Reno fire bubbles and blue gel at it, everything clangs off its armour with zero effect, and Poko admits that burst its confidence.

Page 6: the dinos complain that their ammo was eaten for breakfast, CC-01 reports that protocol zero has woken up, Mecha Rover steps out of the smoke in front of the whole crew, and its helmet closes on a red-eyed stare with a to-be-continued card.
